entries.contribution: Meanwhile got invited by Shine to go Do Nothing along with Atelier and Kaylan at his sister’s house by the lake to wash off all the moon dust 😊🙏

I spent 1.5 hour brewing the ice cold cacao and walking the faire grounds to offer it to vendors 

I think this approach of directly serving samples of cacao to every single vendor at their booth suggested by Atelier is more well suited for such kinds of gatherings if the intention is to acquire vendors 

Might end up being more scalable than holding cacao circles directly targeting consumers since most consumers as observed is usually a one off hence the CAC (_customer acquisition cost_) versus the LTV (_customer life time value_) is not as positive on the _Return on Capital_ deployed 

To optimize the model, you want to drive down *_CAC*_ as much as possible and target demographics with the highest possible *_LTV X Conversion rates*_ multiple 

ideally if possible drive CAC down to Zero, hence why I have been spending time doing all the trash run to get pass the gates free of charge and systematically utilizing food banks to cut down food related operating expenses
